title: AI From Zero
subtitle: Pune ki ek chhoti si team ne ek privacy guard banaya, aur seekha ki AI products asal mein kaise bante hain
tagline: Yeh kitaab padhne ke liye hai, course karne ke liye nahi. Wahi ideas, wahi kram, wahi shabd jo course app mein hain, bas ek lambi kahani ki tarah.
artLabel: Ek chat message jisme personal details chhupa di gayi hain

sections.title: Woh problem jo hal karne layak hai
sections.blurb: Anaya ko chat mein kuch ajeeb dikhta hai, aur woh seekhti hai ki product wala insaan kaise tay karta hai ki kya banana hai aur kya chhod dena hai.

sections.title: Machine se mulaqaat
sections.blurb: Language model kya hai, usse baat kaise karte hain, aur kaise pata chalta hai ki usne achha kaam kiya ya nahi.

sections.title: Cheezein dhoondhna, aur poori machine
sections.blurb: Lambe documents, shabdon se aur matlab se search, aur kaise saare hisse milkar ek chalta hua system banate hain.

sections.title: Machine ko kaam dena
sections.blurb: Tools, sochne wale models, dushman text, hazaaron jawaabon ki grading, aur sab kuch kitne mein padta hai.

sections.title: Asli duniya ki uljhanein
sections.blurb: Scans aur photos, kya bhejna theek hai, niyam, badalte rehne wali cheez ki spec, aur galat jawaab ke liye design.

sections.title: Bonnet ke neeche
sections.blurb: Plumbing, model chunna, review mein tikne wala retrieval, agents, awaaz aur tasveerein, release gates, aur sabse bura maan kar chalna.

sections.title: Ek asli product, aur ek naukri
sections.blurb: Product ko ship karna, uski keemat tay karna, usse badhana, gina-na, asli users ke saath chalana, aur is kaam ke liye naukri paana.
